title: Disciplines
intro: From competitive racing to relaxed touring, Forth Canoe Club covers a wide range of paddling disciplines. All Single day sessions led or coached are included in the Session subscriptions.
slalomBody:
Navigate downstream through hanging gates against the clock.
A technical challenge that develops precise boat control. Included in session subscriptions.
poloBody:
Team sport combining paddling and ball handling, with beginner-friendly, intermediate and advanced sessions.
Play in Scottish divisions or just for fun.
sprintBody:
Flat-water racing from sprint speed trials to long distance marathons, with sessions in summer and winter.
Compete nationally or just enjoy smooth paddling and great technique.
whitewaterBody: Explore Scotland's rivers with the rush of moving water. Includes white water trips for adventure, white water racing for speed, and river coaching. Trips organised by request.
touringBody: Relaxed paddling on lochs and slow rivers. Explore the Scottish landscape by boat. Perfect for those wanting to escape without the competitive edge.
surfBody: Ride sea swells and enjoy coastal paddling. FCC has produced world-class surf kayakers including Neil Baxter. Feel the adrenaline and fresh sea air.
